result.description:
As a Service Technician, you will provide professional support to our customers through mechanical troubleshooting, overhauls, repair, service and reporting of spark ignition natural gas engines, compressor and controls issues. Your innate ability to produce high volume, quality output, coupled with a natural ability to build meaningful relationships are key pillars for success in this role.

Your day-to-day includes:

· Perform timely and efficient mechanical troubleshooting, repairs and service to customer equipment in remote environments.

· Provide clear accurate technical advice and economical solutions to challenges in the field including assisting clients with maintenance strategies to improve reliability of plant and equipment.

· Provide clear and concise reports on work completed in order to indicate to the customer work performed and any future work or process recommendations.

· Maintain a high level of QHSE awareness sand encourage participation among fellow employees in the assessment of risks & monitoring the progress of HSE performance. Immediately report all Health, Safety and Environment incidents to your manager.

· Maintain company tooling and equipment on site and in the workshop to an above average standard of use at all times.

· Assist with the identification of continuous improvement opportunities and participate in the development and implementation of solutions.

· Equipment failure analysis and reporting.

· Ability to multi-task and work autonomously.

· Accept responsibility for your workmanship and the development of positive customer relations.

· Demonstrate a willingness and capability to perform other duties as deemed appropriate and consistent with your professional qualifications, skill or experience.

Job Type: Permanent
Roster: 15 days on, 13 days off
Hours: 37.5 averaged hours per week over 4 weeks
Yearly Salary: $140,000 - $155,000 base per year

About us
Altrad is a trusted provider of expert construction and integrated maintenance solutions across Australia, with a strong track record across key sectors such as energy, mining, utilities, and defence. We are known for managing some of the nation's most critical projects.
We go beyond simply building, protecting, and extending asset life. We cultivate strong, collaborative partnerships with our clients, allowing us to tailor solutions to their evolving needs and ensure their assets operate seamlessly for longer.
We are part of the Altrad Group, a global organisation with nearly 52,000 people across more than 50 countries and 120 subsidiaries operating in Europe, the Americas, Canada, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia Pacific.
Why you should work for Altrad
We provide the benefits you’d expect from a global company, but what makes us different?

Our Opportunities: Embark on a thrilling journey with us, tackling diverse and exciting challenges on some of the world's most prominent resources, energy, and infrastructure projects.
Our Vibrant Culture: Immerse yourself in a dynamic atmosphere where problem-solving is a way of life. Join a reliable and enthusiastic team that thrives on a 'can-do' spirit, making every workday an opportunity for growth and collaboration.
Our Investment in You: Your success matters to us, and we're here to support your aspirations. Let us be your partner in reaching new heights and unlocking your full potential. Your journey to success starts here!
Our global workforce drives and promotes an inclusive culture, both within our organisation and throughout the communities we interact with across the world. Diverse backgrounds include First Nations Peoples, people with differing abilities, LGBTIQ+ community, gender, neurodiverse, cultural diversity, all age groups, and those with an intersectional or multiple diverse characteristics. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

How to Apply:
If you are a motivated and experienced Insulator looking for new opportunities, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your expression of interest along with your resume and relevant certifications by clicking on “Apply Now” or call Recruitment on 1300 142 806.

result.description:
AMA 

AMA Group is the leader in collision repair, with the biggest network of facilities across Australia and New Zealand, supported by Australia’s leading distributor of vehicle parts and accessories. Our Team provides repairs for light to high-severity collisions — on everything from small private vehicles and prestige cars to commercial trucks and buses. With around 3,500 people across approximately 150 locations, we deliver outstanding customer service and get over 300,000 people and businesses back on the road every year. With AMA Group, you can go anywhere.

 

 CAPITAL SMART 

With over 50 repair centres across Australia and New Zealand, Capital S.M.A.R.T is the industry leader We are the pioneers of customer satisfaction and innovation standards, and pride ourselves on providing our employees with safe, supportive, and rewarding working conditions. With an extensive network across Australia and New Zealand, as part of our Team, you can go anywhere.

 

ACM PARTS

ACM Parts is Australia’s largest provider of alternative and specialty parts to the automotive repair industry, keeping vehicles on the road. We are reimaging the way vehicles can be repaired by providing a choice of options that suit their needs. We offer a comprehensive range of Reclaimed, Genuine, and Aftermarket parts as. ACM Parts is reinventing the quality and service standards of the repair industry. It’s our mission to re-define and repair.

 

The Opportunity
We have an exciting opportunity for Centre Manager at either of our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team. This is a full time position. 

Reporting to the State Operations Manager, you will take ownership of this centre by providing leadership and motivation to your team whilst having a significant impact on the day to day operational running of the site. This permanent full-time role will be provide you with opportunities for growth, stability and security as part of the bigger AMA Group. 

Role responsibilities
Production Workshop Management: oversee production management of the workshop to ensure targets are achieved and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition in accordance with AMA and Work Provider quality expectations.

Quality, Quotes, Parts and Vehicle Management: ensure comprehensive and accurate quotes, QA inspections and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition. 
Customer Service and Stakeholder Management: provide exceptional customer service to all clients and work providers through prompt, professional and friendly interactions.
Profit and Loss, Reporting and Administration: ensure the site is operating profitability. Prepare and review P&Ls, Budgets, Job costings, KPIs, Management Reports by utilising the tools provided to understand site performance.
Leadership and People Management: oversee staffing on site and ensure staffing levels and processes are in place. Proactively build and maintain positive work provider relationships.
Work Health and Safety (WHS): ensure that the site remains safe by maintaining the WHS management system, all WHS policies and procedures are followed and safety incidences/near misses are immediately reported and actioned.
 

Benefits

Reward & recognition
Career development and training
Referral bonus for recommending a friend to work with us
Discounts on parts and tools
Uniforms
24/7 professional counselling for Team members and their immediate families
We champion our Team, because it’s our people that set us apart and drive our business' success. We focus on individual strengths and value differences to bring the best out of people, enhancing their skills and capabilities to build fulfilling careers. 

AMA Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to finding the best fit for every role. All qualified applications will be considered regardless of gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, disability, or sexual orientation.

No matter who you are, if you have the drive and talent to progress, when you’re part of our Team, you’re going places - APPLY NOW.

JBS Australia is Australia's largest and most respected meat and food processing company. As part of the JBS Australia Group, Andrews Meat Industries (AMI) provides vibrant long-term career prospects.

About the Role
There is an exciting opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Lidcombe Site, this is a full-time role to provide data analysis, reporting and commercial support to the Commercial Business Units to facilitate informed decision-making and business performance improvement. The annual salary for this role is not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

Key Responsibilities:
Generating and maintaining automation of Sales reports and functions (weekly, monthly, ad-hoc)
Help in Managing and maintaining Cost Prices and standard Prices
Assisting with ad-hoc data requests and projects as needed
Gathering data from various sources, cleaning, formatting, and preparing it for analysis. Retrieving data as requested by other team members or department
Ensuring the confidentiality and security of sensitive information
System Maintenance (Automated reports, ongoing auditing of data maintenance of program)
Updating internal and external pricing/costings
Problem solving – identifying and understanding the root cause, highlighting any risks, proposing solution, executing and/or escalating to Commercial Manager
Internal system maintenance including Inventory maintenance and creating codes for new product lines
Maintain and create effective and efficient work processes and procedures. Compile, file and complete client tender documentation
Analysing and interpreting sales, pricing and operational data to identify trends, patterns and business insights, and producing analytical reports and insights to support commercial decision-making
Collaborating with management and internal stakeholders to determine data requirements, reporting objectives and methodologies for data collection and analysis
Evaluating the accuracy, reliability and integrity of source data and implementing data validation procedures to maintain data quality standards
Performing data mining and data cleansing activities to identify trends, anomalies and opportunities for process improvements and business optimisation
Developing and maintaining dashboards, charts and visualisations to communicate analytical findings and business insights to management and stakeholders
Applying data analytical tools and techniques to transform, process and interpret business data for reporting and decision-making purposes
Utilising reporting and database tools to automate data extraction, processing and visualisation activities
Preparing analytical reports, presentations and recommendations to support strategic planning and operational decision-making

About you:
Relevant Bachelor degree or higher qualification, plus at least 1 year of full-time experience in a similar role
Advanced Excel and reporting skills (PivotTables, VLOOKUP and formulas)
Able to communicate and work with various stakeholders to understand data and support decision making
Strong data literacy
High attention to detail and accuracy
High organisational skills
Relevant experience within the manufacturing industry would be an advantage

The ad is valid for 28 days.
